nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, each finite place $v$ of $K$ is regarded as a place of $K$ via the inclusion of the finite places into the disjoint union of the infinite and finite places of $K$.
nodes.title: Finite places as places

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, each infinite place $v$ of $K$ is regarded as a place of $K$ via the inclusion of the infinite places into the disjoint union of the infinite and finite places of $K$.
nodes.title: Infinite places as places

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$ and let $v$ be an infinite place of $K$, with absolute value $|\cdot|_v$ and multiplicity $m_v$, equal to $1$ if $v$ is real and $2$ if $v$ is complex. The degree-normalized absolute value at $v$ is the absolute value $x \mapsto |x|_v^{m_v/d}$ on $K$.
nodes.title: Degree-normalized absolute value at an infinite place

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$ and let $v$ be an infinite place of $K$, with absolute value $|\cdot|_v$ and multiplicity $m_v$, equal to $1$ if $v$ is real and $2$ if $v$ is complex. For every $x \in K$, the degree-normalized absolute value of $x$ at $v$ equals $|x|_v^{m_v/d}$.
nodes.title: Value of the degree-normalized absolute value at an infinite place

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$, let $v$ be a finite place of $K$, and let $\mathfrak{p}$ be the nonzero prime ideal of the ring of integers of $K$ that defines $v$. For every $x \in K$, the degree-normalized absolute value of $x$ at $v$ equals $|x|_{\mathfrak{p}}^{1/d}$, where $|x|_{\mathfrak{p}} = N(\mathfrak{p})^{-v_{\mathfrak{p}}(x)}$ for $x \neq 0$ and $|0|_{\mathfrak{p}} = 0$, with…
nodes.title: Degree-normalized finite absolute value through the prime ideal

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$ and let $v$ be a complex infinite place of $K$, with absolute value $|\cdot|_v$. For every $x \in K$, the degree-normalized absolute value of $x$ at $v$ equals $|x|_v^{2/d}$.
nodes.title: Degree-normalized absolute value at a complex place

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$ and let $v$ be a real infinite place of $K$, with absolute value $|\cdot|_v$. For every $x \in K$, the degree-normalized absolute value of $x$ at $v$ equals $|x|_v^{1/d}$.
nodes.title: Degree-normalized absolute value at a real place

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$ and let $v$ be a finite place of $K$, with absolute value $|\cdot|_v$. For every $x \in K$, the degree-normalized absolute value of $x$ at $v$ equals $|x|_v^{1/d}$.
nodes.title: Value of the degree-normalized absolute value at a finite place

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $d = [K : \mathbb{Q}]$ and let $v$ be a finite place of $K$, with absolute value $|\cdot|_v$. The degree-normalized absolute value at $v$ is the absolute value $x \mapsto |x|_v^{1/d}$ on $K$.
nodes.title: Degree-normalized absolute value at a finite place

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the places of $K$ form the disjoint union of the infinite places of $K$ (the absolute values coming from complex embeddings of $K$) and the finite places of $K$ (the absolute values coming from nonzero prime ideals of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$).
nodes.title: Places of a number field

nodes.summary: Let $v$ be a finite place of a number field $K$ and $\mathfrak{p}_v$ the corresponding nonzero prime ideal of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. The residue norm $N(v)$ is the absolute norm $|\mathcal{O}_K / \mathfrak{p}_v|$ of $\mathfrak{p}_v$, the cardinality of the residue field at $v$, regarded as a real number.
nodes.title: Residue norm of a finite place

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
